technical-summary: Remove the non-native planning path from the serving component: the plan_engine_only fallback loop (plan-cache, plan-extra, five-round retry), EnginePlanInputs.runner and ManifestRunner, the unreferenced resources::derive_launch adapter and its helpers, and the dead mock tests. plan_engine_only now refuses a start without an admitted native config YAML. Adds native_only_planning_refusals to session_test.
user-summary-candidate: No user-visible change: a fresh serving start already required a native YAML; the unreachable older planning code is removed.
